product_overview: A universal, multi-brand marketing automation platform that combines AI-powered creative studio tools, campaign planning, approval workflows, and publishing orchestration. It supports isolated workspaces, deterministic fallback behavior, and regulatory/budget guardrails for safer marketing operations.
core_goals: Enable dynamic multi-brand workspace switching with isolated brand scoping and no hardcoded brand dependencies.
Provide AI-powered product photography and video generation tools for marketing creatives.
Support a guided, multi-channel campaign planning workflow with deterministic strategy synthesis and budget protection.
Enforce approval state transitions and required comments before publishing.
Deliver a closed-loop lifecycle from brand intelligence through analytics and next-best-action recommendations.
Prevent unsafe or non-compliant usage through health-claim detection, zero-spend sandbox mode, and strict budget constraints.

features.name: Universal Multi-Brand Workspace
features.description: Allows users to create, switch, and operate within isolated brand workspaces with onboarding support and workspace-scoped data access.
user_flows: POST /api/workspaces with brand details -> Receive 201 with new workspace context -> GET /api/workspaces/current with workspace token -> Receive current brand-scoped workspace data -> GET /api/brands with workspace token -> Receive isolated brand list for the active workspace

GET /api/workspaces/current without an active workspace -> Receive 404 or 400 indicating no workspace selected -> POST /api/workspaces/switch with invalid brand/workspace id -> Receive 404 with workspace not found error -> GET /api/brands with no valid workspace context -> Receive 403 or empty scoped response

features.name: Scalio-Inspired Creative Studio Suite
features.description: Provides AI product photography, AI video generation, and a central media asset library for managing generated creative assets and variations.
user_flows: POST /api/studio/photo/generate with product keyframes and lighting preferences -> Receive 200 with generated product image assets -> POST /api/media/assets to store generated images -> Receive 201 with saved media asset records -> GET /api/media/assets with workspace token -> Receive 200 with centralized asset library entries

POST /api/studio/video/generate with vertical video prompt, motion settings, and asset references -> Receive 200 with playable preview metadata and render job details -> GET /api/studio/video/{job_id} -> Receive 200 with render status and preview URL -> POST /api/media/assets with completed video output -> Receive 201 with stored video variation

POST /api/studio/photo/generate with malformed or missing product inputs -> Receive 422 validation error -> POST /api/studio/video/generate with unsupported aspect ratio or invalid asset reference -> Receive 400 or 422 with generation error details

features.name: AlmostZero-Inspired Campaign Automation
features.description: Guides users through campaign planning, strategy synthesis, budget ceiling enforcement, and approval-based campaign execution across channels.
user_flows: POST /api/campaigns/planner with objective, channel allocation, date range, and budget ceiling -> Receive 200 with provider-agnostic strategy synthesis -> POST /api/campaigns with the approved plan -> Receive 201 with draft campaign record -> PATCH /api/campaigns/{campaign_id}/approval with status pending_review -> Receive 200 with updated approval state

POST /api/campaigns/planner with budget ceiling below minimum allowed -> Receive 400 with budget cap protection error -> POST /api/campaigns with missing required objective or channels -> Receive 422 validation error -> PATCH /api/campaigns/{campaign_id}/approval with invalid transition to approved -> Receive 409 or 400 with state machine rejection

features.name: Closed-Loop Marketing Lifecycle
features.description: Supports the full lifecycle from brand intelligence and strategy to creative generation, approvals, publishing calendar management, analytics, and next-best-action recommendations.
user_flows: GET /api/brands/{brand_id}/intelligence -> Receive 200 with brand intelligence signals -> POST /api/campaigns/planner with intelligence-informed inputs -> Receive 200 with strategy output -> POST /api/creative/briefs -> Receive 201 with creative brief linked to the campaign -> POST /api/publishing/calendar -> Receive 201 with scheduled publishing entry -> GET /api/analytics/campaigns/{campaign_id} -> Receive 200 with performance metrics and next best action

GET /api/analytics/campaigns/{campaign_id} without published or tracked activity -> Receive 200 with deterministic mock analytics or empty metrics -> GET /api/publishing/calendar?channel=invalid -> Receive 400 or 422 with channel filter validation error -> PATCH /api/publishing/calendar/{entry_id} with invalid timezone or date conflict -> Receive 409 or 400 with rescheduling failure

features.name: Regulatory & Budget Guardrails
features.description: Detects restricted health or medical claims, enforces strict positive budget constraints, and supports a zero-ad-spend sandbox mode with deterministic demo behavior.
user_flows: POST /api/claims/check with ad copy containing AYUSH/FDA-sensitive health claims -> Receive 200 with violation detection and compliance flags -> POST /api/campaigns/planner with zero-spend sandbox enabled -> Receive 200 with deterministic strategy and no spend allocation -> GET /api/analytics/campaigns/{campaign_id} -> Receive 200 with mock analytics instead of live spend data

POST /api/claims/check with compliant ad copy -> Receive 200 with no violations detected -> POST /api/campaigns/planner with negative budget or non-positive cap -> Receive 400 with strict budget validation error -> POST /api/campaigns with sandbox disabled and unauthorized spend request -> Receive 403 or 400 with guardrail enforcement
